entities.name: Alaüddevle Bozkurt Bey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ala al-Dawla Bozkurt Beg was the ruler of Dulkadir in southern and central Anatolia from late 1480 until his death. Championed by the Ottoman Sultan Mehmed II, Bozkurt ousted his brother Shah Budak and claimed the throne.
